title: Wheel of Dreams
description: A lone figure in a coat stands on a rocky cliff overlooking a misty, ruined cityscape under a glowing full moon. A large ornate wooden wheel floats in the sky amid colorful swirling clouds, paint splashes, and light rays, all enclosed in a thick, textured painterly frame decorated with buttons, keys, feathers and roots.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a solitary figure standing on a cliff overlooking a dark ruined city under a bright full moon. A large ornate wooden ship's wheel floats in the sky surrounded by swirling colorful clouds, paint splashes and dramatic light rays. The entire image is contained within a thick impasto painterly frame adorned with antique keys, buttons, feathers and roots.
